The '''Double Bed''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|2000}} after the player's farmhouse is [[Farmhouse#Upgrades|upgraded]] for the first time.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

The original [[Single Bed|Bed]] that comes with the [[Farmhouse]] is automatically changed into a Double Bed when the house is [[Farmhouse#Upgrades|upgraded]] for the first time.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.5|Beds can now be moved.}}
